description: Discovery labels for the DENSE single-domain fixture (`corpus-dense/`, GH #196/#197 Phase 0b): fifteen backyard-beekeeping notes, ALL genuinely inter-related, deliberately NO loner and no negative anchor — the vault-level geometry the orthogonal corpus is structurally incapable of expressing (its process-rule-2 token audit minimizes shared vocabulary; this corpus maximizes it, because a research vault, a project vault, or a single-subject zettelkasten shares one domain's vocabulary everywhere). GH #196 measured what that geometry does to any anchor-local z existence gate: with no unrelated tail, the population mean is 'moderately related' rather than noise, every leader's z compresses toward zero, and the gate empties every pane — 16 of 17 notes dark on the reporting vault — which is why the labels here are RANKINGS ONLY (expected mates per anchor, scored per-mate) and the fixture's twin assertions are a per-mate MRR floor and ZERO EMPTY PANES across every note in the corpus. The fixture is scored in its own throwaway vault and its own results.jsonl row (corpus id 'dense'), never averaged with the orthogonal corpus's. Each anchor's expected mates are the notes a human would file next to it INSIDE the shared domain — the sub-cluster structure the ranking must recover: the varroa cluster (varroa-mites / mite-treatments / drone-comb, with hive-inspection carrying the monitoring overlap), the swarm-and-queen cluster (swarm-season / swarm-prevention / queen-rearing / queenless-colony), the stores cluster (honey-harvest / winter-prep / feeding-bees / robbing-behavior), and the getting-started cluster (package-vs-nuc / hive-types / apiary-siting). Process rule 2 binds here in its within-corpus form: there are no retrieval queries to audit, so the two-direction audit becomes a claim about the labels — every expected mate must share NAMED content with its anchor that the note text actually expresses (varroa-mites names the wash and the threshold that mite-treatments picks up; drone-comb's trap is varroa control in its own words; swarm-season's charged queen cups are what swarm-prevention's split answers; queenless-colony's emergency cells are queen-rearing's reflex; honey-harvest's open-honey warning is robbing-behavior's ignition; winter-prep's syrup-while-warm is feeding-bees' autumn ratio) — and a red per-mate number is argued against the NOTES, never cleared by editing a label. Unlabelled pairs are not claims of unrelatedness — in this corpus everything relates; the labels claim only which notes belong NEXT TO each anchor, which is exactly the relative question GH #197 ruled discovery answers.
